observations: Photo 0 shows four red gas cylinders standing upright on a concrete ground.
The cylinders have a red metal handle and valve assembly on top.
The largest cylinder in the foreground has a white label with 'CAL' and '47kg' visible, but the full text is cut off.
The label appears slightly worn and smudged, with some discoloration and minor scratches.
The cylinders show signs of use: minor dents, scratches, and surface wear.
The background includes a person and some outdoor items, suggesting a yard or storage area.
No visible damage to the body of the cylinders, but no inspection for cracks or corrosion is possible from this angle.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gas cylinder, but there is no visual proof of it being empty. The label '47kg' suggests it holds gas, but the cylinder may still contain residual gas or be partially filled.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may still contain residual gas or be partially filled, making it unsafe or unusable.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve and cylinder body showing no residue, and a pressure test or inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not empty, or as potentially unsafe, with reduced value.

risks.risk: The cylinder may have hidden damage such as cracks or corrosion not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cylinder body, especially near the base and valve, under good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, with reduced value.

risks.risk: The cylinder may not be certified or may be from a non-compliant source.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder's certification label or inspection stamp, if any.
risks.if_unproven: priced as uncertified, with reduced value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the cylinder body showing the full label and any certification marks.
Close-up photo of the valve and cylinder body under good lighting to check for residue or damage.
Photo of the cylinder's certification label or inspection stamp if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
